core.headline: Extended family home with double garage on 0.3-acre plot
core.summary: Extended detached family home on a 0.3-acre plot in Sevenoaks, offering a kitchen/family room, two reception rooms, four bedrooms, two bathrooms and a double garage with driveway parking.
core.listing:
This extended four-bedroom detached house stands on a 0.3-acre plot on Beech Avenue. Built in 1968, the property offers a kitchen/family room, two reception rooms, two bathrooms and a double garage with driveway parking.

The extended kitchen/family room forms the principal living space on the ground floor. Two reception rooms provide additional living accommodation. The ground floor is served by gas central heating.

Four bedrooms are arranged on the first floor, served by two bathrooms. The principal bedroom occupies the front aspect.

The 0.3-acre plot extends to the rear. A double garage stands to the side, accessed from the driveway. Off-street parking is provided on the driveway.

Beech Avenue is located in Sevenoaks TN13. Mains electricity, water and sewerage are connected; the water supply is metered. FTTC broadband is available, and good outdoor mobile coverage is provided on major networks.

Guide Price £850,000. Freehold. Council Tax Band G (Sevenoaks District Council). EPC rating D. Standard construction. Japanese knotweed found in the rear garden near the boundary in 2025; herbicide treatment plan by a PCA-registered contractor in progress, with a 10-year insurance-backed guarantee. Building safety, restrictions, rights and easements, flooding, coastal erosion, planning, accessibility and coalfield/mining: none known.
